_comment: THE CRAB'S CIVICS STAKES, TRANSCRIBED (cultureway phase E4, plan section 2).
platValue (game.js) scores every platform for a voter as SIX coefficient
terms; here it is re-expressed as a LIST of NAMED Layer-1 term-programs.
The platform's value is the SUM of the terms - so the receipt (which term
dominated, read off the largest-magnitude name) and the valuation come from
ONE definition, which is substrate section 3's legibility ruling.
THE READS (PLAT_BUNDLE, game.js): the nine numbers platValue touches, each
an ENGINE call. Two of the underlying helpers - floorBill (a loop over a
payroll) and capStake100 (a loop over the businesses) - are LOOPS, which a
straight-line program cannot express, so the engine computes every helper
in platReads and the term-programs do only the coefficient arithmetic
platValue's own body does, in source order. slot 0 potStake20, 1 pBowls,
2 roofWeight20, 3 roof(0/1), 4 fr, 5 fb, 6 capStake100, 7 purseCost100,
8 pTake.
THE COEFFICIENTS are D/denominator, D = 41,400,000 (game.js): 345000 =
414000 = D/100, 69 = D/(100*6000). floorBill and purseCost SUBTRACT, so
their coefficients are negative and their term bounds go negative - which
the stakes validator permits (a stake term is signed; only the 2^52
magnitude rail applies).
WHAT THE PROOF IS, EXACTLY - and here it IS byte-equality, unlike the E3
depart table's scaled space. Every read platValue touches is an exact
integer, so the summed term value equals the lambda value bit-for-bit on a
(real crab, real platform) grid sweep. MEASURED 2026-08-24 across four
towns (poor + growth, both engines), 205,800 pairs, ZERO mismatches, ZERO
clamps, and every +/-1 coefficient mutation flips hundreds of pairs - so a
wrong coefficient is VISIBLE, the one class of drift E3's scaled space
could not catch. The engine lambda remains the fallback; the grid sweep and
the whole-town election run are the proof.
